pins.title: Black Friday luxury perfume 2026: the codes that actually work
pins.description: Luxury perfume houses don't cut prices for Black Friday. The stores do. Bergdorf Goodman's BGBEAUTY takes $50 off $250 of beauty (Tom Ford Oud Wood 50 ml: $300 to $250). Bluemercury's free BlueRewards lists 20% off $200+ (Parfums de Marly Delina 75 ml: $410 to $328). Neiman Marcus has THANKFUL. Every price dated, checked Nov 23, 2026. Affiliate links on the page. #ad #blackfriday #luxuryperfume
pins.alt: Typographic list on cream titled 'Black Friday: the codes that work.' Bergdorf Goodman BGBEAUTY, $50 off $250 of beauty, Oud Wood 50 ml $250. Bluemercury BlueRewards, 20% off $200 and up, Delina 75 ml $328. Neiman Marcus THANKFUL, up to $1,500 off regular-price orders. Footer: the bottles themselves did not go on sale.

pins.title: Is Tom Ford Oud Wood on sale for Black Friday?
pins.description: Is Tom Ford Oud Wood on sale for Black Friday 2026? The bottle isn't: Bergdorf Goodman listed 50 ml at $300 on Nov 23. The code is: BGBEAUTY takes $50 off $250 of regular-price beauty, so it lands at $250. Not sure it's your scent? A 1 ml sample is $6.99. Affiliate links on the page. #ad #tomford #blackfriday

pins.title: Is Baccarat Rouge 540 on sale for Black Friday? No.
pins.description: Is Maison Francis Kurkdjian Baccarat Rouge 540 on sale for Black Friday 2026? A 1 ml sample is $9.99, which is the move if you've only ever smelled it on a stranger in an elevator. Affiliate links on the page. #ad #baccaratrouge540 #blackfriday
